Impression:
The AI model assigns an abnormality score of 1.5%, below the configured decision threshold. This score is uncalibrated and is not a probability of disease.

Visual Findings:
Model attention primarily focuses on the upper central area of the radiograph. Attention does not establish a lesion or its absence; image position does not verify anatomy or patient laterality.

Clinical Context:
Clinical indication terms 'breath', 'XXXX-year-old', 'male' were associated with a higher abnormality score. Clinical indication terms 'with', 'shortness' were associated with a lower abnormality score. These associations describe model sensitivity, not the clinical significance of symptoms.

Recommendation:
Routine radiologist review. A Normal prediction does not exclude disease. Clinician verification is required.
